description_full: Metaplanet Inc. owns and operates a hotel and bitcoin-focused operations in Japan and internationally. It operates through Hotel Business and Bitcoin Related Business segments. The Hotel Business segment provides accommodation and related hotel services. The Bitcoin Related Business segment offers bitcoin derivatives. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Minato, Japan.

financial_summary: Metaplanet Inc. is a small-cap financial services business with a $1.9B market cap on $56M of annual revenue.

The top line has compounded at +177% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder. Operating margins are expanding by +101.7pp year-over-year, which is one of the strongest signals that the moat is deepening.
Returns on capital run at -8% against a 9% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests. Gross margins of 87% confirm genuine pricing power.
The business throws off $37M in free cash flow — roughly 66 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders.
Accruals are elevated at -20.1% of assets, and Sloan showed firms building earnings through accruals rather than cash systematically underperform.
On the balance sheet, debt is heavy at 6.5× net debt/EBITDA, and leverage like that is what turns a bad year into a permanent loss.
Insiders hold 8.8% of the shares, and within its sector the business captures 2.7× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
